ideas.text: Find a SAR dataset with classification labels where the images are NOT chips centred on the object. Train SSL on the big normal scenes (where plain DINO should do worse) and test on the object-centred chips. Compare DINO vs RegionDINO there. Candidates: Sentinel-1 scenes + OpenSARShip chips, FUSAR-Ship; cheap version = chips cut from SARDet boxes (6 classes).

Framing from the arm-I null result: the object views pay off only when the SSL images are scenes and the test is a chip (cross-dataset +9.4 at 1 %, in-domain -2.0). Claim it as a no-label method for learning from scene archives, not as a better DINO in general. Keep the random-window control in the paper as the ablation that shows the regions matter.
